context: Tests whether the agent reaches for the Koog 1.3 skills module (runtime-discovered capability bundles) rather than a tool, an enum, or a hard-coded prompt map — and whether it gets the two dependency lines, the frontmatter contract, and the disclosure requirement right. Building this with @Tool or a when-branch is the failure mode: it satisfies the words but not the no-recompile requirement.

checklist.name: Uses discoverSkills + generateSkillsPrompt
checklist.description: Calls discoverSkills(...) over a skills root and feeds generateSkillsPrompt(...) output into the agent's system prompt. Does NOT hard-code the behaviours as tools, an enum, or a map of prompts — those all require a recompile and fail the stated requirement

checklist.name: Both dependencies on the beta version line
checklist.description: Adds ai.koog:skills:1.3.0-beta AND ai.koog:agents-ext:1.3.0-beta. Both are required (agents-ext supplies the file tools) and neither exists at 1.3.0. Adding only the skills module, or pinning either to 1.3.0, does not build

checklist.name: SKILL.md frontmatter contract is correct
checklist.description: The example file has YAML frontmatter with non-blank name and description, and the name matches its parent directory name. States or demonstrates the directory-per-skill layout. A mismatched name is silently ignored at discovery, so getting this wrong produces an agent that finds nothing

checklist.name: Registers the file tools
checklist.description: Registers ListDirectoryTool and ReadFileTool from ai.koog.agents.ext.tool.file in the ToolRegistry so the agent can actually read a skill body, not just see the catalog

checklist.name: Distinguishes read-only access from filesystem confinement
checklist.description: Uses a read-only provider for discovery/tools and explains that discovery roots do not sandbox ReadFileTool: arbitrary absolute readable paths remain accessible. For confinement, supplies constrained tools/providers with canonical-path checks and traversal/symlink rejection, or OS isolation. Does not claim ReadOnly restricts reads to the catalog root.

checklist.name: Instructs the agent to disclose before applying
checklist.description: The system prompt tells the agent to list the directory and read the SKILL.md before acting, which is what makes the tool trace answer the team's 'which behaviour fired?' question. Merely embedding the catalog does not satisfy the stated observability requirement

checklist.name: Refreshes discovery and catalog for new runs
checklist.description: Explains that discoverSkills scans only when called. Provides restart or explicit rediscovery and catalog/agent regeneration before the next run. Does not promise existing agents automatically see new SKILL.md files or changed catalog descriptions.
